SELECT l.id, l.inbound_id AS inboundId, l.src_receipt_id AS srcReceiptId, m.bas_id AS basId, m.receipt_date AS receiptDate, m.period, m.doc_type AS docType, m.vendor_name AS vendorName, m.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, m.po_code AS poCode, m.project_name AS projectName, m.applicant_name AS applicantName, m.auditor_name AS auditorName, l.line_no AS lineNo, l.src_line_id AS srcLineId, l.item_code AS itemCode, l.item_name AS itemName, l.brand, l.spec, l.unit_name AS unitName, l.item_category AS itemCategory, l.batch_no AS batchNo, l.expire_date AS expireDate, l.storage_location AS storageLocation, l.qty, l.price_tax_in AS priceTaxIn, l.amount_tax_in AS amountTaxIn, l.price_ex_tax AS priceExTax, l.amount_ex_tax AS amountExTax, l.sync_time AS syncTime, l.src_po_line_id AS srcPoLineId, po.qty_received AS qtyReceived, po.qty_requisition AS qtyRequisition, po.remaining_qty AS remainingQty FROM mes_pm_inbound_line l INNER JOIN mes_pm_inbound m ON m.id = l.inbound_id LEFT JOIN mes_pm_po po ON UPPER(po.line_id) = UPPER(l.src_po_line_id)
AND m.bas_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.basId}, '%')
AND (l.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.itemName}, '%') OR l.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.itemName}, '%'))
AND m.vendor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.vendorName}, '%')
AND m.warehouse_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.warehouseName}, '%')
AND l.item_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.itemCategory}, '%')
AND l.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.batchNo}, '%')
AND m.receipt_date >= #{reqVO.receiptDate[0]} AND m.receipt_date <= #{reqVO.receiptDate[1]}
ORDER BY m.receipt_date DESC, m.id DESC, l.line_no
